body: From the DM-170 review (orchestrator, this run): pin in tests (1) same-call observation ids read back in call order including after export/import; (2) a mutual citation (A cites B, B cites A in one call) is accepted by recordObservations but both files are rejected on import on every reconcile — decide (same-call citations only to earlier entries) and pin; (3) idAllocator `SELECT MAX(id) … WHERE recorded_at = ?` (observations.ts ~245) has no index on (recorded_at, id); (4) nextStableId throws a plain Error on id overflow instead of a DomainError.
